answer.title: Automated Booking Reschedule from Helpdesk
answer.trigger: A helpdesk ticket is received requesting a change of booking time.
steps: Read the incoming helpdesk ticket for the requested booking time change.
Use AI to extract the customer details and the new requested time.
Find the existing booking in the jobs system.
Draft the booking reschedule in the jobs system.
Wait for Claire to approve the schedule change.
answer.ai_help: Extracting the customer name, identifier, and new time from the helpdesk ticket text.
answer.human_approval: Claire must review and approve the booking reschedule in the jobs system before it is finalized.
answer.risk_reason: Rescheduling the wrong booking or picking the wrong time could disrupt customer service and lead to missed appointments.
